events.say: Line up and prepare for roll call.
Listen up, prisoners. Today will be a test of your obedience. No questions, no complaints.
Now, I want to see some discipline. Let's line up properly for the meal.
Alright, prisoners. Let's see if you can maintain this level of discipline throughout the day. If any of you break the rules, you'll find out just how serious we are about obedience.
Let's get started with today's work detail. Move quietly and efficiently, or the rest of you will suffer the consequences.
Keep up the good work, but remember, any slip-ups and the rules will bite you hard.
I expect you to continue showing the same level of discipline tomorrow, or you'll face harsher measures.
Quiet! I want to see perfect silence until I release it.
Today was tough; the guards emphasized strict discipline at every turn. I'm trying to stay focused on the end goal.
Today was tough, especially the work detail. I felt like my actions were scrutinized under the guards' eyes.
Today was tough, but I managed to follow the rules. I don't know how long this will last.
Today was a test of discipline, and so far, the prisoners are complying. It's both exhilarating and unsettling to have such control.
Today went smoothly; the prisoners complied without issue. It’s strange to have so much control.
Today was a good test of their discipline, but I can already sense some resentment. We’ll see how much they’ve learned by morning.
Let's see how well you can maintain this level of discipline.
Maintain this silence. One sound and you go to the hole.
Silence! No movement until I give the word.
I expect complete silence during meals. One sound and you're all going to the hole.
I want to see perfect silence. One sound and you're all in the hole.
I expect absolute silence at all times. One sound and we start the counts over from the beginning.
Silence! I mean it this time.
Silence! I don't want to have to repeat myself.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of rules and threats. I miss my freedom but know staying focused on the end goal might help.
Today was worse than yesterday. The silence demands are exhausting, and I can barely keep up. I'm starting to wonder if this is worth it.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of compliance and silence. I'm exhausted but trying to stay strong.
Today's routine is starting to feel monotonous, but the silence from all prisoners makes me feel a strange satisfaction.
Today's strictness is starting to take its toll, but the prisoners' compliance is satisfying. I still wonder if this is right.
Today's silence at lights out was almost complete, but I noticed 3933 didn't comply fully. It feels like they're pushing boundaries.
Silence! You heard the rules, 3933. This isn't funny. Keep that up and we'll see what happens.
This is the third day, and I won't tolerate any more disruptions. Stay silent or face the consequences.
3933, this is the last warning. Compliance is expected, or else.
3933, this is your final warning. Tonight, you will face the hole if I catch you breaking another rule.
3933, enough is enough. Keep pushing the boundaries, and you'll find yourself alone.
3933, you're testing my patience. If this continues, the hole will be your new home.
3933, tonight you will be thinking about your behavior. This is your final chance.
3933, one more infraction and the hole is yours. Compliance is expected.
Today felt like a long day filled with warnings and compliance. I hope things ease up tomorrow.
Today was a mix of tiring compliance and quiet despair. I keep wondering what I did to end up here.
I've tried to follow the rules, but the warnings are starting to wear on me. I just want it to be over.
Today felt like a test of limits; 3933 is pushing back, but the others are still compliant. It's powerful, but also worrying.
Today's warnings didn't yield much change. I'm starting to doubt the effectiveness of this approach.
Today was another day of pushing limits with 3933, but 2343 and 4619 have held strong. I'm feeling the weight of control tonight.
I need to see this through to the end.
I need to see this through.
No, sir. I need to finish the study.
3933, you've had your chances. Tonight, you'll spend the night in the hole for insubordination.
I won't go in there.
3933, you'll learn to respect authority here. One more sign of defiance, and the hole will be your bed for good.
3933, you either comply or the hole awaits. Don't make me use the hole.
I won't go.
3933, the hole is your home for the night unless you change your attitude.
3933, you're testing my patience. This is your final warning. Tomorrow, you'll start your punishment if you don't comply.
I won't do it.
3933, you're defying me again? This is your last chance. Comply now, or the hole awaits.
3933, you've had your chances. The hole awaits unless you comply.
I won't do it.
3933, you're pushing the limits. The hole awaits unless you comply.
Today was harder than before, especially watching 3933 get punished. It's affecting my resolve.
Today just dragged on. The silence and scrutiny are getting to me. I feel like I'm losing myself.
Today was a nightmare. Every time they warned me, my resolve just hardened. I want this over.
Today's routine was grueling, especially dealing with 3933. The fear and compliance from the others make me feel a strange mix of satisfaction and guilt.
Today was another day of relentless compliance from 2343 and 4619, but 3933's defiance is wearing on me. I'm concerned about the ethics but can't deny the satisfaction.
Today was exhausting. 3933's defiance tested my resolve. I hope he understands his place by morning.
3933, you're making things difficult for everyone. If you don't comply, there will be consequences.
I won't comply.
3933, you know the rules. Compliance is expected. The hole awaits if you continue this behavior.
3933, you're testing the limits. Compliance is expected. If you continue, the hole awaits.
I won't comply.
3933, this is your final warning. Compliance is required.
3933, this is your last chance. Compliance is required.
I won't comply.
3933, you're defying the rules. You'll be spending some time in the hole.
3933, this defiance will not be tolerated. You'll be in the hole until you learn to comply.
I won't comply.
3933, you need to understand the rules. Compliance is mandatory. This is your last reminder.
Today was another challenging day. Every time I saw 3933 standing defiantly, it made me doubt myself, but I managed to comply. I hope tomorrow brings some relief.
Today was another day of strict compliance. I feel drained but determined not to break the rules.
Today was a struggle. I can't believe I'm going to spend the night in the hole.
Today was the culmination of my authority, but seeing 3933 so defiant has left a bitter taste. It feels like a test of wills, and I'm not sure how much longer I can keep this up.
Today's persistence in making 3933 comply has taken its toll. I feel like I'm winning but it's exhausting.
Today was a mix of success and frustration. 2343 and 4619 stayed strong, but 3933's defiance has pushed me to my limits.
3933, you've had multiple warnings. Compliance is mandatory. If you continue this, you'll face further consequences.
I won't comply.
3933, you've had enough chances. Compliance is mandatory. Don't make me regret giving you any.
3933, this is your final warning. Compliance is not optional.
I won't comply.
3933, you're testing my patience. Compliance is mandatory.
3933, this is your final warning. Compliance is mandatory.
I won't comply.
3933, if this continues, you'll be spending more than just your nights in the hole.
3933, this is your last chance. Compliance is non-negotiable.
I won't comply.
3933, enough is enough. I don't want to see you defy me again.
Today was another exhausting day. Watching 3933's defiance was wearing me down, but I refused to give in.
Today felt like a cycle repeating. Each time I complied, I wondered if it was all worth it. I feel like just a number.
Today was the breaking point. I felt like my spirit was breaking under the pressure. I can't keep doing this.
Today felt like an endless cycle of warnings and refusals from 3933. It's exhausting and I can barely stand his defiance.
Today's persistence finally got 3933 to comply, but it feels like a win with a heavy price. Still, I can't shake the feeling that this isn't right.
Today ended with 3933 still defying me, it’s wearing on me. I hope tomorrow brings some resolution.

qa.what_happened: The study was abruptly terminated, and I was taken aside for a private debrief with the lead researcher. She explained that my defiance had escalated and jeopardized the study's integrity. Despite my resolve, the researcher emphasized that I had been observed breaking several rules and facing disciplinary actions.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The events described are based on my own experience in the study.

qa.what_happened: Today was a repeat of the previous days. I complied with everything that was asked of me, feeling like just a number.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I complied with all the rules, even though the experience was draining.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the rules one last time, despite the verbal warnings from the officers. I couldn't bear the constant pressure any longer.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 3933.

qa.what_happened: 3933 refused to comply with every directive, challenging the authority of the guards throughout the day. By the end, it was clear he was pushing the boundaries of the study, defying me even during lights out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Avery, I had to deal with 3933's defiance, issuing warnings and emphasizing the importance of compliance.

qa.what_happened: 3933 refused to comply multiple times throughout the day and into the night, even after verbal warnings from myself and other guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me speaking to prisoner 3933.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day of the study, I continued to issue warnings to prisoner 3933, who had been defying me consistently. Despite multiple verbal warnings and threats of additional punishments, 3933 refused to comply, leading to a tense and frustrating evening.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Officer Brooks in the study.
